data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek huios, meaning 'son' or 'descendant', and manas, meaning 'mind' or 'spirit'. In Christian context, Hinman represents a man or woman wholly dedicated to God. The name Hinman carries the meaning “Man of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hinman usually hope their child will grow to embody man of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion and submission to the divine.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hinman total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
